params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
$runner=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'actions-runner-heaven'
$listeners=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.Name -eq 'Runner.Listener.exe' -and $_.ExecutablePath -and $_.ExecutablePath.StartsWith($runner,[System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)} | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,ExecutablePath,CreationDate,CommandLine)
$workers=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.Name -eq 'Runner.Worker.exe' -and $_.ExecutablePath -and $_.ExecutablePath.StartsWith($runner,[System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)} | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,ExecutablePath,CreationDate,CommandLine)
$task=Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'GitHub Actions Runner - heaven' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$taskInfo=if($task){Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName 'GitHub Actions Runner - heaven' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue}else{$null}
$startup=Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Startup')) 'HeavenGitHubActionsRunner.vbs'
[pscustomobject]@{
 listener_count=$listeners.Count
 listeners=$listeners
 worker_count=$workers.Count
 workers=$workers
 scheduled_task=if($task){[pscustomobject]@{state=$task.State;run_level=$task.Principal.RunLevel;last_run=$taskInfo.LastRunTime;last_result=$taskInfo.LastTaskResult}}else{$null}
 startup_fallback_exists=(Test-Path -LiteralPath $startup)
 startup_fallback=$startup
 runner_dir=$runner
} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 -Compress
